description: Schedule or update PLANNED future exercises on a signed-in athlete's STRUGGL training calendar across one or multiple dates (`replace=true` overwrites existing planned entries on covered dates while leaving completed logs untouched) and syncs a workout card to the STRUGGL app. Use only for upcoming workouts (prefer `sessions` batch array); to record already-completed training, use `log_workout` instead. Requires `write`-scoped Bearer or OAuth 2.1 token.

comments.description: Optional pacing target, rest interval, or technical cue for single-exercise planning.

date.description: Target calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (required for single-exercise calls; fallback date for `sessions`).

debrief_summary.description: Concise coaching rationale displayed beneath the planned card in the STRUGGL app.

distance_km.description: Prescribed distance in kilometers for running, rowing, SkiErg, or cycling.

duration_min.description: Prescribed duration in minutes for endurance or mobility sessions.

exercise.description: Exercise name when scheduling a single movement (omit when passing `sessions`).

replace.description: When true, replaces existing planned exercises on covered date(s) instead of appending.

reps.description: Prescribed repetitions per set for single-exercise calls (1–100).

rpe.description: Target RPE (1–10). When omitted, inferred deterministically from the athlete's rolling 30-day e1RM capacity envelope.

session_title.description: Optional planned session card header title (e.g. 'Hyrox Threshold + Sleds').

sessions.description: Batch of planned exercises (across one or multiple dates) to schedule atomically.

comments.description: Optional coaching cue, split target, tempo note, or athlete feedback.

date.description: ISO calendar date YYYY-MM-DD for this item (inherits top-level `date` when omitted).

distance_km.description: Distance covered in kilometers for running, rowing, SkiErg, or cycling.

duration_min.description: Total duration in minutes for endurance, conditioning, or mobility blocks.

exercise.description: Canonical or natural movement name (e.g. 'Back Squat', 'Pull-Up', 'Zone 2 Run').

exercise_type.description: Movement modality classification used for volume vs endurance load routing.

reps.description: Target or completed repetitions per working set (1–100).

rpe.description: Borg CR10 / RIR-based session or set RPE (1–10; sets < 6.0 are excluded from hypertrophy hard-set volume).

session_aim.description: Optional physiological aim of this session (e.g. 'Aerobic base + lactate clearance').

session_title.description: Optional per-day session card header when batching a multi-day plan.

sets.description: Working set count for strength or interval prescriptions (1–50).

weight_kg.description: External load in kg (ADDED belt load for pull-ups/chin-ups/dips; total bar+plates for barbell lifts).

sets.description: Prescribed working set count for single-exercise calls (1–50).

weight_kg.description: Prescribed load in kg (ADDED belt load for pull-ups/chin-ups/dips; total bar load otherwise).

name: plan_workout

advisories.description: Deterministic capacity-ceiling or RPE-consistency guardrail warnings.

result.description: Summary of scheduled or replaced calendar items.

saved.description: True when the planned workout item(s) were written to the calendar.

trace_id.description: Audit trace identifier linking calendar rows and app feed cards.

title: Plan Scheduled Workout (Single or Batch)
